sql_templates.description: Retrieve recent signal outcomes with their success metrics and current stage info.
sql_templates.template:
SELECT 
  s.symbol, 
  s.date_issued, 
  s.price_at_issue, 
  s.return_pct, 
  s.hit_target, 
  s.hit_stop, 
  ss.stage, 
  ss.technical_score 
FROM 
  signals.signal_log s 
JOIN 
  scores.stage_snapshots ss ON s.symbol = ss.symbol 
AND ss.snapshot_date = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM scores.stage_snapshots) 
WHERE 
  s.date_issued = (SELECT MAX(date_issued) FROM signals.signal_log) 
ORDER BY 
  s.return_pct DESC 
LIMIT 10;
